page.layout: One running head centred at the top. Below it, the year 1644 and two parallel columns, Oppidani (left) and Agrarij (right), with their names. Then a centred heading. Then a table with a year column on the left and two columns, Oppidani and Agrarij. The 1604 row carries a bracketed note inside its cell. A short word "Idem" stands at the lower right, outside the table.

main_text.l: Albert Wijffering. | Oesebrant Reng. van Slocht.
main_text.head: IN ILLUSTRI COLLEGIO GENERALIUM ORDINUM ADSESSORES.
main_text.l: 1595 | Joachimus Alting. | Johannes Rengers then Hellum.
| ( cui mortuo hoc anno successit ABELIS COENDERS ejusdem avunculus. ) |

page.notes: The year 1644 under the running head is read as a date, not a page number, so no page number is given. The long s in the running head, the Latin words and the names are printed as plain s, as the rules require. The table's year figures are printed in a stylised form; they are copied as 1595 to 1605. The bracketed 1604 note stands inside the Oppidani cell and is transcribed as one line. The word "Idem" at the lower right is set outside the table and is copied as a separate line. The black mark at the top left of the page is not printed text and is left out.
